plain_text:
Researchers across NIH are collaborating on research to
determine how the COVID-19 virus behaves in children and
how it can lead to long-term conditions like long COVID
and MIS-C.

plain_text:
The COVID MUSIC Study. The Long-term Outcomes
after the Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome In Children
(MUSIC) study is looking at how MIS-C affects children’s
health—both in the short term and over time. This study,
which is happening through the NHLBI-funded Pediatric
Heart Network, is taking place at multiple hospitals and
medical centers across the country and has recruited more
than 1,200 children and adolescents in little more than a
year. The study has a specific focus on health disparities
